# Brainstorming

Start from the user problem and project constraints. Generate a varied but
manageable set of ideas, group related options, then assess value, effort,
dependencies, and risk. Include the option to keep the current system unchanged.
Do not convert ideas into code or a committed roadmap unless asked.
